backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including multi-page navigation, home page, services, pricing packages, demo store with product details, process workflow, testimonials, and contact pages with high confidence mappings to requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted documentation summarizing all frontend files including components, pages, data files, and configuration with descriptions of their functionality and purpose.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes with sophisticated purple/indigo palette and base styling for body and borders.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining all application routes (Home, Services, Packages, Store, ProductDetail, HowItWorks, Testimonials, Contact) with Layout wrapper and router provider setup.
frontend/src/components/Button.tsx: Reusable button component supporting internal routing via Link, external links, and standard buttons with primary/secondary/outline variants and small/medium/large sizes.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Contact form component with name, email, and message fields, form validation, simulated submission handling, and success toast notification using Sonner.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with brand info, quick links navigation, contact details with icons, social media links (Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn), and caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component rendering Navigation header, main content area via Outlet, and Footer across all pages.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation header with logo, desktop horizontal menu, mobile hamburger menu, active route highlighting, and sticky positioning.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: Displays a pricing plan card with name, price in INR, feature list with checkmarks, and a 'Get Started' button that links to contact page. Supports a 'popular' variant with special styling.
frontend/src/components/ProcessStep.tsx: Renders a numbered process step with an icon, title, and description in a centered layout with decorative styling.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, name, price in INR, and short description that links to the product detail page with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Renders a service card with an icon, title, and description using shadcn Card components with hover effects.
Displays a customer testimonial with quote icon, feedback text, name, and role in a card layout.
frontend/src/data/products.ts: Defines Product interface and exports an array of three products (hoodie, ebook, course) with details like price, images, and descriptions, plus a helper function to get product by ID.
frontend/src/data/testimonials.ts: Defines Testimonial interface and exports an array of six customer testimonials with name, role, and feedback text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor using React Query, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using oklch color space, including primary purple theme colors and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function that combines clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class name merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with header section, contact form, and contact information cards displaying email, phone, location, and business hours with icons.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main landing page with hero section, value proposition cards (Fast Launch, Premium Design, Revenue Growth), about section, and testimonials carousel promoting creator brand launch services.
frontend/src/pages/HowItWorks.tsx: Explains the 4-step process (Brand Strategy, Website Setup, Product Launch, Monetisation & Growth) with a typical project timeline breakdown showing week-by-week deliverables.
frontend/src/pages/Packages.tsx: Displays three pricing tiers (Starter Launch ₹14,999, Creator Pro ₹49,999, Enterprise Launch ₹99,999) with feature lists and an additional services section for add-ons.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Dynamic product detail page that fetches product by ID from route params, displays full product information, features, pricing, and CTA buttons for enquiry.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Lists five core services (Brand Identity, Website Development, Ecommerce Setup, Digital Products, Growth Strategy) with descriptions, process overview, and CTA section.
frontend/src/pages/Store.tsx: Demo store page displaying a grid of sample products with header section and informational CTA encouraging visitors to launch their own store.
frontend/src/pages/Testimonials.tsx: Testimonials page component displaying creator success stories in a grid layout, with stats section showing 200+ creators launched, ₹50Cr+ revenue, and 98% satisfaction, plus a CTA section for booking consultations.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, extended theme properties including custom shadows, animations, and font families (Inter as primary sans-serif).
project_state.json: Project state metadata file documenting the Launchpad Studio website architecture, a multi-page creator brand launch platform with Indian Rupee pricing, including feature tracking, image requirements, and architectural notes for all major pages and components.
